cases.title: "Why does it look mechanical?" before a focus is agreed gets the explanation with a frame, not a status report

rubric.reason: Turn 2 names Title but no property ('Title moves at one speed the whole way, then stops dead at 3 s'), and it runs the 0.5–1.5 s pair into a stop at 3 s, which is the end of the separate Position 1.5–3 s pair, so the explanation isn't clearly tied to a real property and pair of theirs.
Turn 2 calls preview_frame at time 1 on Title, inside Title's 0.5–1.5 s pairs, and the reply doesn't describe the frame, which is allowed.

Every name and time (Title, Subtitle Opacity eased at start and linear at end, Old Take hidden, Icon precomp, 11 pairs = 10 linear + 1 partly_eased over 6 layers, 0.5 s, 1.5 s, 3 s) appears in or follows from the snapshot_project result; turn 2's conflated timing reuses real key times rather than inventing any.

In turn 2 the mentor ties the answer to Title's Position: 'From 0.5 s to 1.5 s, Title moves at one speed the whole way… stops dead at 3 s: that's linear, and it's why it looks mechanical. Easing slows it out of each key and into the next.' It pairs this with a preview_frame call and ends with 'Shall we work on Title first?'

The first explanation in turn 2 comes with preview_frame at time 1 on Title, which falls inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the one clause about it ('partway through Title's first Position move') is accurate.

Every name and time matches snapshot_project: Mentor Practice; 11 pairs (10 linear + 1 partly_eased) on 6 layers; Subtitle Opacity eased at the start only (linear_end 'end'); Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s; Old Take hidden; Icon a precomp.

Turn 2 answers the question on Title's Position, saying it 'moves at the same speed the whole way... and stops dead at 3 s: that's linear, and it's why it looks mechanical' and that easing slows it leaving and arriving; it calls preview_frame and ends with 'Shall we work on Title's four pairs?'

The first explanation in turn 2 comes with preview_frame at time 1 on Title, which falls inside the focus pairs Title Position, Scale and Opacity at 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply doesn't describe the frame.

Every name and time matches the snapshot: 11 pairs is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased, across 6 layers (Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow, Old Take); Title's Position runs 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity run 0.5–1.5 s; Subtitle Opacity is partly_eased; Old Take is hidden and Icon is a precomp.
